limitations: Post-hoc geometric description; not a causal classification of failure.
4 cm lift and 7 cm proximity are analysis thresholds, not LIBERO success thresholds.
Contact sheets show policy observation frames, not every simulator step; MP4 files contain every step.
Post-hoc diagnosis of a selected task, not a suite-wide non-inferiority gate.
Official LeRobot uses shared BF16-rounded explicit noise, not its stock FP32 sampler.
All arms share the qualified simulator and input adapter; common-mode adapter errors remain possible.
Trace and video collection adds overhead; these timings are not a speed qualification.
